annotations.title: Calculate IELTS Band Score & Canadian CLB

description: Calculates official IELTS Overall Band scores (with 0.25/0.75 half-band rounding rules), converts Listening and Academic/General Training Reading raw scores (0-40) into Band scores, computes weighted Writing Band (1/3 Task 1 + 2/3 Task 2), and maps scores to Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB 4-10) for Express Entry.

examTrack.description: IELTS exam module ('academic' or 'general_training'). Defaults to 'academic'.

listeningBand.description: Listening band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if listeningRawCorrect is provided.

listeningRawCorrect.description: Number of correct Listening answers out of 40 (0-40).

readingBand.description: Reading band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if readingRawCorrect is provided.

readingRawCorrect.description: Number of correct Reading answers out of 40 (0-40). Uses official Academic vs GT conversion tables.

speakingBand.description: Speaking band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments).

writingBand.description: Writing band score (0 to 9 in 0.5 increments). Optional if writingTask1Band and writingTask2Band are provided.

writingTask1Band.description: Writing Task 1 band score (weighted 1/3 of total Writing score).

writingTask2Band.description: Writing Task 2 band score (weighted 2/3 of total Writing score).

name: calculate_ielts_band_score
